draft.subject: Noon report nr-0102 (22 Jan 2025) — VLSFO consumption verification request
draft.body:
Dear Captain,

We are reviewing noon report nr-0102 for 22 Jan 2025 for MV TORMAR SPRING (SIM-0002).

The report shows VLSFO consumption of 27.6 t over the last 24 h, against the charter party warranted figure of 24 t/day. This represents a 15% excess above the 10% tolerance. Weather over the period was within good-weather limits (maximum Beaufort 4, maximum Douglas 3), so it does not explain the excess.

Could you please verify the VLSFO consumption figures for the last 24 h against tank soundings and flow meter readings, and revert with your confirmation?

Thank you and best regards,
[Operator]

Noon report nr-0104 for MV TORMAR SPRING (SIM-0002) has been fully checked. The report extracted cleanly with no missing figures and no discrepancies versus the prior report. The Master's ETA of 2025-01-31 03:00 UTC is consistent with the computed ETA, and no charter party ETA notice is due now. Fuel consumption of 28.3 t VLSFO runs 17.9% above the warranted 24 t/day, but the day is excluded from the warranty assessment because heavy weather (Beaufort 10 wind, Douglas 8 seas versus CP limits of 4 and 3) explains the excess; a voyage note was filed and nothing needs to be sent on consumption.

However, the forecast puts the ETA at risk: the forecast ETA is 2025-01-31 20:48 UTC, about 17.8 hours after the Master's ETA, exceeding the CP's 12-hour change limit. Per procedure, nothing goes out until you decide. I have asked you: Should I ask the Master to review the ETA in view of the forecast? If you say yes, I will draft that message for your approval.
